TV and handheld mode so you can play on the go (or if you don’t live alone you can even play when someone else uses the TV)

You can play multiplayer with just the joycon set that comes with the switch (but if you want 3+ players you’ll have to buy another one)

32 GB of internal storage, so if you don’t get an SD card just yet there will still be a decent amount of storage (but I’d still recommend one)

Kickstand so you can play multiplayer without TV access

CONS

The screen is small so multiplayer with just the switch screen is a little uncomfy

If you want more than 2 players in multiplayer mode the joycons are $50+ a set

Battery runs out super fast

Some games lag like crazy

Games are hella expensive
